title: Autoship Streak Rate on Missed Earnings — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Training Questions
content:
**What is the Autoship streak rate?**
On a **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** missed-earning posting, an Autoship streak rate is added to the missed-earning rate, in points per qualifying dollar, according to how many charged shipments the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry dated in the last six months.

**What are the bands?**

| Charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated in the last six months | Streak rate added |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 1.0 |
| 3 to 5 | 0.4 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

**Which shipments are counted?**
Every charged shipment on any of the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions, dated in the last six months — not only the subscription of the shipment being posted.

**Hypothetical: two subscriptions, one with 3 charged shipments and one with 2, all in the last six months.**
5 shipments: 0.4 is added.

**Hypothetical: the same customer with one more charged shipment in the window.**
6 shipments: 1.0 is added.

**Hypothetical: 2 charged shipments in the window.**
Fewer than 3: no streak rate.
